x-changelog.summary: Added assets_enabled and locations_enabled to Action Plans list-templates response
x-changelog.description: Two new per-template booleans added to the project plan_templates list endpoint (normal and full views): `assets_enabled` indicates whether the template's plan type has the `assets` configurable field visible for the current project, and `locations_enabled` indicates the same for the `location` configurable field. Both are computed against the project's configurable field set so clients can show/hide the corresponding asset/location pickers without a follow-up CFS lookup.
